caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, wooden wall clock with a pendulum. The clock case is primarily brown with red undertones and a lighter beige vertical panel on the lower half. The upper section of the clock contains a square dial with a cream background, black Roman numerals, and the year “1840” printed at the top center inside the dial. The clock face has two black hands, one pointing at IX (9) and the other between I (1) and II (2). The case has a domed top with two small semicircular accents and a flat ledge projecting slightly outward. The section below the clock face has a vertically aligned rectangular door with a clear central panel revealing a brass or gold-colored circular pendulum disk hanging from a thin rod. The entire clock is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Shaker Wall Clock
